violations.reason: tests/accessibility/theme-contrast.test.ts implements a self-contained mock RuntimeThemeManager with local static fixtures (themeVariants) instead of importing or testing production DesignTokenCompiler or real Obsidian design tokens (#08090C, #11141C).
